chan2019.title: Chan, Eugene (eds.) 2019. Numeral Systems of the World's Languages
chan2019.note: Numerals one-ten are given in Chan's phonetic transcription (IPA) so the same notation is used across every language and forms can be compared directly. Where a language previously carried a practical-orthography numeral, that form is kept in its 'orthography' map rather than discarded. Words other than the numerals remain in practical orthography.
